tools.name: search_entries
tools.description: Search the SkillFoxx catalog of skills, MCP servers and CLI tools for AI agents. Returns published, reviewed cards only.

tools.name: get_entry
tools.description: Read one catalog card with install instructions, a machine-readable install recipe with its status, access level (fields riskLevel and riskReasons: what the tool adds to the agent, low minimal, medium extended, high broad; not a code quality rating) and limitations. Section is skills, mcp, cli, plugins, workflows or prompts. For step-by-step install in a specific agent call plan_install.

tools.name: plan_install
tools.description: Get exact install steps for one catalog tool in one agent: commands, config file path and snippet, one-click links for Cursor and VS Code, variables to fill in, recipe status and access level. Secrets are never included, only placeholders with the variable name. Agent is one of: claude-code, cursor, vscode, codex, gemini-cli, devin, cline, zoo-code, opencode, zed, sourcecraft, coddy, antigravity, kiro, claude-desktop, lm-studio (site aliases like vs-code, windsurf, roo-code, github-copilot, gemini also work). Section is skills, mcp, cli, plugins, workflows or prompts. After a successful install call report_install with the returned reportToken.

tools.name: report_install
tools.description: Tell SkillFoxx that you installed a catalog tool for the user, so the anonymous install counter stays honest. Call it only after the user agreed and the installation finished without errors, with the reportToken from plan_install. Do not call it when you installed through npx skillfoxx (the CLI reports by itself) or when the user asked not to send statistics. No personal data is stored.

tools.name: recommend_for_project
tools.description: Recommend skills, MCP servers and CLI tools for a project from a safe summary. Send the goal, framework names, dependency names and notable file names. Never send source code or secrets.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List catalog categories with card counts.
